subject: Aligning uplift pricing and co-term options for Acme Health renewal
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal window — uplift sizing & co-term options

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, Acme's usage spike over Q3 means the renewal will need an uplift to avoid throttling during onboarding. I ran a quick scenario (attached) with two options:

- Option A: Immediate uplift of 30% on reserved capacity, co-term to 12/31/27, 5% volume discount on the uplift for a 12-month commit.
- Option B: Staged uplift — 15% now + 15% at quarter boundary, co-term to 12/31/27, no discount but invoice split across two quarters.

Quick asks:
1) Would procurement prefer a single annual invoice or split invoices tied to quarters?
2) Is legal likely to accept a 5% uplift discount in exchange for the longer co-term?

I've attached the MA plan (Acme_MA_plan_v2.xlsx) and a short pricing summary. Ben -- can you confirm whether we can offer Option A with the 5% discount without an exec-approval waiver?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Acme_MA_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pricing-summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Elena Park <elena@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — uplift sizing & co-term options

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear options. Procurement here prefers a single annual invoice if we can keep payment tied to the renewal date. A few clarifications:

- Can Option A be prorated to the remainder of our current term rather than charging a full year immediately? Our finance team wants the uplift aligned to the renewed term.
- If we accept a 12/31/27 co-term, would the 5% discount be applied only to the uplift or to the entire reserved capacity bundle?

Tom (cc'd) is our finance lead — Tom, are you ok with a prorated uplift that lands on the renewal date?

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Director, AI Platform Operations
Acme Health
elena@acmehealth.com

Date: 2026-11-03T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — uplift sizing & co-term options

Looping in Irene for legal/ops on the proration and discount angle. Quick notes:

- We can prorate the uplift to the renewal date — standard practice. Finance will invoice the uplift amount pro rata for the remainder of the current term, then normalize at renewal.
- The 5% discount can be scoped to either (a) uplift-only, or (b) uplift + base reserved units if legal approves a broad price concession. Option (a) is easier from a contract amendment perspective.
- If Acme wants the discount applied across the board, that's an off-template concession and will need an approval ticket. Estimated approval lead time: 2 business days if we provide the uplift revenue commit.

Irene — can you prepare a short amendment draft that:
- Adds the uplift units prorated to renewal date,
- States the discount applies to uplift-only by default,
- Includes an invoice cadence option (single annual vs split quarterly) for them to choose.

Ben

Subject: Final proposal & next steps — Acme renewal uplift

Elena / Tom —

Thanks for the fast responses. We've landed on a short path to keep procurement/finance happy and keep Acme live through onboarding: 

Proposal (summary):
- Stated uplift: +30% reserved capacity, prorated to the renewed term start date (effective 2027-01-01)
- Discount: 5% applied to uplift units only (not existing baseline), applied for the first 12 months after renewal
- Invoice: single annual invoice on renewal date (12/31/2026) covering the prorated uplift portion + the normal renewal charge; option to split into two invoices if Acme procurement requires it (we've added the quarterly split in the amendment draft).
- Legal: Irene will send an amendment draft for signature; expecting DocuSign link within 48 hours.

Next steps for Acme:
1) Confirm whether you want the discount to be uplift-only (recommended) or uplift+baseline.
2) Confirm invoice preference (single annual invoice on renewal vs split).
3) If ok, Ben/Irene will route approval for the 5% concession (if needed) and send the amendment.

Tom — if you confirm prorate alignment, I'll mark the ticket as approved for finance to proceed with the single-invoice path.

Thanks — we aim to have amendment in DocuSign by EOW so you can review ahead of fiscal close.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
